Privacy Policy

Transparent information regarding how personal data is collected, handled, and protected by our firm.

ICAI Professional Confidentiality

Privacy Policy & Data Handling Practices

At Y K Chaturvedi & Co., Chartered Accountants (ICAI Firm Registration No. 145633W), safeguarding the privacy and confidentiality of our website visitors and clients is fundamental to our practice. As Chartered Accountants governed by the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949 and the Code of Ethics established by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), we maintain strict standards of professional secrecy and data integrity.

This Privacy Policy describes the actual data collection, processing, storage, and protection practices of our official website (https://ykchaturvedi.com/).

A. Personal Information We Collect

We only collect personal information that you voluntarily choose to submit through our website's consultation and enquiry forms. Based on our active enquiry form fields, we collect:

  • Full Name: To identify you and personalize our communications.
  • Company / Entity Name: (Optional) To understand your business context where applicable.
  • Phone Number / Mobile Number: To contact you directly regarding your service enquiry.
  • Email Address: To send formal responses, consultation schedules, and submission confirmations.
  • Service Requirement / Practice Area: The specific practice area selected (e.g., Audit, Direct Tax, GST, Business Setup).
  • Preferred Office Location: Your preferred meeting location (Head Office Vasai West or Branch Office Vasai East).
  • Enquiry Message: Any details, context, or questions you include regarding your requirements.

Note: Our website does not collect sensitive personal data such as payment card numbers, bank account credentials, PAN/Aadhaar biometric details, or password credentials through public forms.

B. How We Use Personal Information

Personal information collected through the website is used strictly for legitimate professional purposes, including:

  • Responding promptly to enquiries and consultation requests submitted by visitors.
  • Communicating with you via telephone, email, or WhatsApp regarding your specific tax, audit, or business query.
  • Scheduling consultation appointments with our partners at our Vasai West or Vasai East offices or through virtual meetings.
  • Providing requested information about the firm's practice areas and statutory services.
  • Conducting preliminary conflicts-of-interest and eligibility assessments prior to formal professional engagement.

C. Personal Data Storage and Handling

We handle and store submitted personal data according to the following verified technical configuration:

  • Database Storage: When an enquiry form is submitted, the record (name, company, phone, email, service, office, message, and submission timestamp) is stored securely in an encrypted local database (SQLite) hosted on the web application server.
  • Server-Side Email Dispatch: Form submissions trigger an automated server-side email notification to the firm's official communication desk (caykc2007@gmail.com) and designated administrative inbox, while delivering an automated confirmation receipt to the submitter's email address.
  • Authorized Access: Access to submitted enquiry data is strictly restricted to our partners (CA Yogesh Kumar Chaturvedi and CA Saurabh Bhutada) and authorized management staff who require the information to review and respond to enquiries.
  • Professional Confidentiality: All personnel with access to client data are bound by professional confidentiality obligations under ICAI regulations and the firm's internal codes of conduct.

D. Sharing of Personal Information

We do not sell, rent, lease, trade, or monetize personal information to any third parties under any circumstances.

Information is only shared under the following strictly verified operational circumstances:

  • Essential Infrastructure Providers: The web hosting provider that maintains the physical server hosting our web application and database, and the SMTP mail delivery service (Google / Gmail SMTP) utilized to transmit notification emails.
  • Embedded Third-Party Tools: Google Maps embedded iframes on our Contact page display our physical office premises; interacting with these maps is governed by Google's independent privacy policy.
  • Statutory & Legal Mandates: Personal information may only be disclosed if required by applicable Indian law, valid court order, judicial process, or formal directive from an authorized statutory regulatory authority (such as the ICAI, Income Tax Department, or GST authorities).

E. Data Retention

We retain submitted personal information only for as long as necessary to address your enquiry, fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, or maintain necessary records of preliminary professional communications.

Pending Client Confirmation: The firm's specific automated data deletion timeline and fixed archival schedule are currently under internal review to align with applicable ICAI record-retention directives and professional compliance guidelines.

F. Cookies and Website Tracking

Our website is designed with a privacy-first approach:

  • No Advertising or Tracking Cookies: We do not deploy third-party advertising cookies, behavioural trackers, marketing pixels, or external web analytics tools (such as Google Analytics).
  • Regulatory Local Storage: We use standard browser local storage (localStorage) solely for a single regulatory function: recording whether you have acknowledged our mandatory ICAI Regulatory Disclaimer popup (ykcca_disclaimer_accepted), so you are not repeatedly prompted on subsequent visits.
  • Administrative Session Cookies: Secure, encrypted session cookies are used solely within the password-protected internal administrative portal (/admin) for authorized staff authentication.

G. Data Protection and Security

We implement practical, reasonable technical and organizational measures to safeguard personal information submitted through our website against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure:

  • Transport Layer Security (HTTPS): Communications between your browser and our server are encrypted using SSL/TLS encryption.
  • Input Sanitization: Form inputs are strictly validated, sanitized, and length-limited prior to storage or email transmission to guard against injection risks.
  • Restricted Access: Internal databases and administrative functions are protected by password authentication and server-side session controls.

Disclaimer: While we implement commercially reasonable security standards, please note that no electronic transmission over the internet or data storage method can be guaranteed as 100% impenetrable.

H. User Rights and Privacy Requests

If you have submitted personal information through our website, you have the right to:

  • Request confirmation of whether we hold personal information regarding you.
  • Request access to the personal data you have provided to us.
  • Request correction, updating, or rectification of inaccurate or incomplete contact details.
  • Request the deletion or removal of your submitted enquiry information, subject to any statutory record-keeping obligations required by law or professional regulators.

To exercise any of these rights, please write directly to our official privacy desk at caykc2007@gmail.com.

I. Contact Information
